The chosen metric is a distribution-based symmetric KL divergence between predicted-probability and label-probability histograms (per priority class, averaged), rolled up as 1 − normalized_KL rescaled to 0–100. Jin Oh owns the implementation and write-up; Alex Chen approved the choice. The driver was the 12% inter-rater noise floor on the golden-set labels — re-labeling would only drop it to ~6% and still leave a noise band that would mask real model improvements.
